_provenance: Shaped to GET /v1/files/{file_key}?depth=2 — DOCUMENT -> CANVAS (one per page) -> top-level children. This is the ONLY payload that carries page names; /nodes returns a node's subtree, never its ancestry. Two pages here own a frame named 'Checkout' (10:2 and 90:2), which is why grouping keys on node_id and only DISPLAYS 'Page / Frame'.
